title: Add a use case
description: Adds a use case under a capability, with its actors in order, the main actor first.

title: Change a use case
description: Changes a use case's title, goal or notes, or its actors (the whole list, in order). Its capability changes only by Move a use case.

title: Move a use case
description: Moves a use case, with everything in it, under another capability of its domain.

title: Remove a use case
description: Removes a use case whole: its actors, requirements, flows, steps, tests and the links they start. Refused while anything outside it references what is in it.

title: Add a UC requirement
description: Adds a UC requirement to its use case.

title: Change a UC requirement
description: Changes a UC requirement's title, statement or group.

title: Remove a UC requirement
description: Removes a UC requirement with its use case tests and the links they start. Refused while a step fulfills it, or anything else references it or its tests.

title: Add a flow
description: Adds a flow to its use case, through one interface of its product: its ID ends in the interface's number.

title: Change a flow
description: Changes a flow's title. Its interface is in its ID, so a flow through another interface is another flow.

title: Remove a flow
description: Removes a flow with its steps, its flow test and the links they start. Refused while anything else references them.

title: Add a flow step
description: Adds a step to its flow, on a path at a position, with the requirements it fulfills, what it invokes, the view it happens in and the integrations it exchanges with.

title: Change a flow step
description: Changes a step's title, path or position, or its links: a list given replaces the list, null clears what it invokes or the view it happens in.

title: Remove a flow step
description: Removes a flow step with the links it starts. Refused while anything else references it.

title: Add a use case test
description: Adds a use case test under its UC requirement, with the test data sets it starts from.

title: Change a use case test
description: Changes a use case test's columns or the test data sets it starts from (the whole list).

title: Remove a use case test
description: Removes a use case test with the links it starts. Refused while anything else references it, such as a business outcome it measures.

title: Add a flow test
description: Adds a flow test under its flow, with the test data sets it starts from.

title: Change a flow test
description: Changes a flow test's columns or the test data sets it starts from (the whole list).

title: Remove a flow test
description: Removes a flow test with the links it starts. Refused while anything else references it, such as a business outcome it measures.

title: Add a product
description: Adds a product, the root of a set of specifications, with its roles.

title: Change a product
description: Changes a product's title, description, icon, color or notes, or its roles (the whole list).

title: Declare a product kind
description: Declares a kind of the product's own, with its fields in order: the next load gives it a table of its own.

title: Change a product kind
description: Changes a product kind's label, description, parent kind, stage, obligation, ID pattern, example or title form, or its fields (the whole list, in order). Refused when a record of the kind no longer fits it.

title: Remove a product kind
description: Removes a product kind's declaration with its fields. Refused while the product has records of the kind, or a relation or kind names it.

title: Declare a product relation
description: Declares a pair of kinds a relation of the product's own may link: a new name gets its own link table, a name Lathe has gains the pair.

title: Change a product relation
description: Changes a product relation pair's role, labels or description; its name and kinds are its key.

title: Remove a product relation
description: Removes a product relation pair. Refused while a link of the pair is left.

title: Add an open question
description: Adds an open question under its product or one of its domains, with the role that decides it and the records it is about.

title: Change an open question
description: Changes an open question's title, owner or description, or the records it is about (the whole list). Its product or domain changes only by Move an open question.

title: Move an open question
description: Moves an open question between its product and one of the product's domains, or from one domain to another of the same product.

title: Remove an open question
description: Removes an open question with what it is about, once it is decided and its answer is written into the records it affects.

title: Add an interface
description: Adds an interface of a product: a way it is used, such as its web app, HTTP API or command line.

title: Change an interface
description: Changes an interface's title, kind or description.

title: Remove an interface
description: Removes an interface. Refused while a flow goes through it, or anything else references it.

title: Add a business outcome
description: Adds a business outcome under its product, with the tests and records that measure it.

title: Change a business outcome
description: Changes a business outcome's title, statement, measure, target, how it is measured outside the code or notes, or what measures it (the whole list). Its product stays.

title: Remove a business outcome
description: Removes a business outcome with the measured_by links it starts. Refused while a capability serves it, or anything else references it.

title: Add an extension record
description: Adds a record of a product's own kind under its parent, with its title and declared fields, the links it starts and the packages it uses.

title: Change an extension record
description: Changes a record of a product's own kind: its title or declared fields, the links it starts by relation, or the packages it uses. Its kind and parent never change.

title: Remove an extension record
description: Removes a record of a product's own kind with the links it starts and the packages it uses. Refused while anything else references it.

title: Add an entry point
description: Adds an entry point under its domain, with the packages it uses and the standard rules it meets.

title: Change an entry point
description: Changes an entry point's title, file, description, packages or standard rules met. Its domain stays.

title: Remove an entry point
description: Removes an entry point whole, with the packages it names and the links it starts. Refused while anything references it.

title: Add a tooling record
description: Adds a tooling record under its domain, with the packages it uses and the standard rules it meets.

title: Change a tooling record
description: Changes a tooling record's title, file, packages or standard rules met. Its domain stays.

title: Remove a tooling record
description: Removes a tooling record whole, with the packages it names and the links it starts. Refused while anything references it.

title: Add a domain
description: Adds a domain to its product, with nothing in it yet.

title: Change a domain
description: Changes a domain's title, subdomain type, description or notes. Its product never changes.

title: Remove a domain
description: Removes a domain whole: its capabilities, terms, domain services with their services and tests, repositories, and the links they start. Refused while anything outside it references what is in it.

title: Add a capability
description: Adds a capability to its domain, at a position, with the business outcomes it serves.

title: Change a capability
description: Changes a capability's title, position or description, or the business outcomes it serves (the whole list).

title: Remove a capability
description: Removes a capability and the links it starts. Refused while a use case sits under it or anything else references it.

title: Add a term
description: Adds a term to its domain's glossary, with what it means there and the terms it builds on.

title: Change a term
description: Changes a term's title, meaning or group, or the terms it builds on (the whole list).

title: Remove a term
description: Removes a term from its domain. Refused while anything references it.

title: Add a domain service
description: Adds a domain service to its domain, with what it must work out.

title: Change a domain service
description: Changes a domain service's title or statement.

title: Remove a domain service
description: Removes a domain service with its service and tests and the links they start. Refused while a command or query calls it, or anything else references it or them.

title: Add a repository
description: Adds a repository to its domain, with the aggregate it persists, the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses.

title: Change a repository
description: Changes a repository's title, file or description, the aggregate it persists (null clears it), or the standard rules it meets or packages it uses (each the whole list).

title: Remove a repository
description: Removes a repository with the links it starts and the packages it uses. Refused while anything references it.

title: Add a service
description: Adds the service that implements a domain service in code, with the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses.

title: Change a service
description: Changes a service's title or file, or the standard rules it meets or packages it uses (each the whole list).

title: Remove a service
description: Removes a service with the links it starts and the packages it uses. Refused while anything references it.

title: Add a domain service test
description: Adds a domain service test under its domain service, with the test data sets it starts from.

title: Change a domain service test
description: Changes a domain service test's columns or the test data sets it starts from (the whole list).

title: Remove a domain service test
description: Removes a domain service test and the links it starts. Refused while anything references it.

title: Add a test data set
description: Adds a test data set to the domain whose tests it serves: where it runs, what it starts with, how to prepare and reset it, and the file that builds it.

title: Change a test data set
description: Changes a test data set's columns. Its domain never changes.

title: Remove a test data set
description: Removes a test data set. Refused while a test starts from it or anything else references it.

title: Add a pattern
description: Adds a pattern to its product, with its settings in order.

title: Change a pattern
description: Changes a pattern's title, description or notes, or its settings (the whole list, in order). Its product never changes.

title: Remove a pattern
description: Removes a pattern whole: its settings, rules and rule tests, and the links they start. Refused while anything outside it references what is in it, such as a follower.

title: Add a pattern rule
description: Adds a rule to its pattern, with the setting of the pattern it depends on, if any.

title: Change a pattern rule
description: Changes a pattern rule's title, statement, group, setting or notes.

title: Remove a pattern rule
description: Removes a pattern rule with its tests and the links they start. Refused while anything references it or them.

title: Add a pattern rule test
description: Adds a test of a pattern rule in one domain that follows its pattern, with the test data sets it starts from.

title: Change a pattern rule test
description: Changes a pattern rule test's columns, the domain it proves the rule in, or the test data sets it starts from (the whole list).

title: Remove a pattern rule test
description: Removes a pattern rule test and the links it starts. Refused while anything references it.

title: Add a standard
description: Adds a standard to its product, with no rules yet.

title: Change a standard
description: Changes a standard's title or description. Its product never changes.

title: Remove a standard
description: Removes a standard whole: its rules and rule tests, and the links they start. Refused while anything outside it references what is in it, such as a technical record that meets a rule.

title: Add a standard rule
description: Adds a rule to its standard.

title: Change a standard rule
description: Changes a standard rule's title, statement or group.

title: Remove a standard rule
description: Removes a standard rule with its tests and the links they start. Refused while a technical record meets it or anything else references it or its tests.

title: Add a standard rule test
description: Adds a standard rule test under its rule, with the test data sets it starts from.

title: Change a standard rule test
description: Changes a standard rule test's columns or the test data sets it starts from (the whole list).

title: Remove a standard rule test
description: Removes a standard rule test and the links it starts. Refused while anything references it.

title: Add an aggregate
description: Adds an aggregate under a domain, with nothing in it yet.

title: Change an aggregate
description: Changes an aggregate's title, description, identity or notes. Its domain does not change.

title: Remove an aggregate
description: Removes an aggregate whole: its entities and their fields, data models, invariants with their rules, tests and the links they start. Refused while anything outside it references what is in it.

title: Add an entity
description: Adds an entity to its aggregate, as its root or a child, with its fields in order and the entities of its aggregate it holds.

title: Change an entity
description: Changes an entity's title, role, description or whether it is stored in its root's table, or its fields (the whole list, in order) or the entities it holds (each list whole). Its aggregate does not change.

title: Remove an entity
description: Removes an entity with its fields, its data model and the links they start. Refused while anything else references them: a command under it, its table, or another entity that holds it.

title: Add an invariant
description: Adds an invariant to its aggregate: a rule that holds on every change.

title: Change an invariant
description: Changes an invariant's title or statement. Its aggregate does not change.

title: Remove an invariant
description: Removes an invariant with its rule and its test, and the links they start. Refused while anything else references them, such as a table key it names.

title: Add a data model
description: Adds the data model of an entity of the aggregate: its name in code and its file, with the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses.

title: Change a data model
description: Changes a data model's title or file, or the standard rules it meets or the packages it uses (each list whole). Its entity does not change.

title: Remove a data model
description: Removes a data model with the links it starts and the packages it uses. Refused while anything else references it.

title: Add an invariant test
description: Adds the test of an invariant, with the test data sets it starts from.

title: Change an invariant test
description: Changes an invariant test's columns or the test data sets it starts from (the whole list).

title: Remove an invariant test
description: Removes an invariant test with the links it starts. Refused while anything else references it, such as a business outcome it measures.

title: Add a rule
description: Adds the rule that enforces an invariant of the aggregate: its name in code, the name its refusal carries, and its file, with the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses.

title: Change a rule
description: Changes a rule's title or file, or the standard rules it meets or the packages it uses (each list whole). Its invariant does not change.

title: Remove a rule
description: Removes a rule with the links it starts and the packages it uses, so its invariant is no longer built. Refused while anything else references it.

title: Add a domain event
description: Adds a domain event to the aggregate it happens to, with the fields it carries, in order.

title: Change a domain event
description: Changes a domain event's title, description or whether it is published, or its fields (the whole list, in order). The aggregate it happens to does not change.

title: Remove a domain event
description: Removes a domain event whole: its fields, its event type and the links it starts. Refused while anything else references it: a command that raises it, a policy that hears it or a read model it feeds.

title: Add an event type
description: Adds a domain event's shape in code: its name, how it is delivered and its file, with the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses. An event has one event type.

title: Change an event type
description: Changes an event type's title, delivery or file, or the standard rules it meets or the packages it uses (each list whole). Its event does not change.

title: Remove an event type
description: Removes an event type with the links it starts and the packages it uses. Refused while anything else references it.

title: Add a command
description: Adds a command under the entity it changes, with the events of its aggregate it raises, the specifications it checks and the domain services it calls.

title: Change a command
description: Changes a command's title or description, or the events it raises, the specifications it checks or the domain services it calls (each list whole). The entity it changes does not change.

title: Remove a command
description: Removes a command whole: its handler, its policies with their event handlers and tests, and the links they start. Refused while anything outside it references what is in it: a step that invokes it, its endpoint or CLI command.

title: Add a command handler
description: Adds the handler that carries out a command: its name in code, its file and what it does, with the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses. A command has one handler.

title: Change a command handler
description: Changes a command handler's title, file or description, or the standard rules it meets or the packages it uses (each list whole). Its command does not change.

title: Remove a command handler
description: Removes a command handler with the links it starts and the packages it uses. Refused while anything else references it.

title: Add a policy
description: Adds a policy under the command it sends, with the one event it hears: its own domain's, or another domain's published one.

title: Change a policy
description: Changes a policy's title or statement, or the event it hears; null clears the event. The command it sends does not change.

title: Remove a policy
description: Removes a policy with its event handler and test and the links they start. Refused while anything else references them.

title: Add an event handler
description: Adds the handler that carries out a policy: its name in code, its file and what it does, with the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses. A policy has one event handler.

title: Change an event handler
description: Changes an event handler's title, file or description, or the standard rules it meets or the packages it uses (each list whole). Its policy does not change.

title: Remove an event handler
description: Removes an event handler with the links it starts and the packages it uses. Refused while anything else references it.

title: Add a policy test
description: Adds the test of a policy, with the test data sets it starts from.

title: Change a policy test
description: Changes a policy test's columns or the test data sets it starts from (the whole list).

title: Remove a policy test
description: Removes a policy test with the links it starts. Refused while anything else references it, such as a business outcome it measures.

title: Add a specification
description: Adds a specification, in the domain its ID names, with the aggregates it reads.

title: Change a specification
description: Changes a specification's title or statement, or the aggregates it reads (the whole list).

title: Remove a specification
description: Removes a specification whole: its predicate and test, and the links they start. Refused while anything outside it references what is in it, such as a command that checks it.

title: Add a predicate
description: Adds the predicate of a specification, its one piece of code, with the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses.

title: Change a predicate
description: Changes a predicate's title or file, or the standard rules it meets or packages it uses (each the whole list).

title: Remove a predicate
description: Removes a specification's predicate with the links it starts and the packages it uses. Refused while anything references it.

title: Add a specification test
description: Adds the test of a specification, its one test, with the test data sets it starts from.

title: Change a specification test
description: Changes a specification test's columns or the test data sets it starts from (the whole list).

title: Remove a specification test
description: Removes a specification's test with the links it starts. Refused while anything references it, such as a business outcome it measures.

title: Add a value object
description: Adds a value object, in the product its ID names, with its fields in order.

title: Change a value object
description: Changes a value object's title or description, or its fields (the whole list, in order).

title: Remove a value object
description: Removes a value object whole: its fields, constraints with their tests and its value type, and the links they start. Refused while anything outside it references what is in it, such as a field it types.

title: Add a constraint
description: Adds a constraint to its value object: a rule each value is held to when it is created.

title: Change a constraint
description: Changes a constraint's title or statement. Its value object never changes.

title: Remove a constraint
description: Removes a constraint with its test and the links it starts. Refused while anything else references them.

title: Add a value type
description: Adds the value type of a value object, its one piece of code, with the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses.

title: Change a value type
description: Changes a value type's title or file, or the standard rules it meets or packages it uses (each the whole list).

title: Remove a value type
description: Removes a value object's value type with the links it starts and the packages it uses. Refused while anything references it.

title: Add a constraint test
description: Adds the test of a constraint, its one test, with the test data sets it starts from.

title: Change a constraint test
description: Changes a constraint test's columns or the test data sets it starts from (the whole list).

title: Remove a constraint test
description: Removes a constraint's test with the links it starts. Refused while anything references it, such as a business outcome it measures.

title: Add a read model
description: Adds a read model to its domain, with its fields in order, the aggregates it reads, the domain services its projection calls and the events that feed it.

title: Change a read model
description: Changes a read model's title or description, its fields (the whole list, in order), or the aggregates it reads, the domain services it calls or the events that feed it (each the whole list). Its domain never changes.

title: Remove a read model
description: Removes a read model whole: its fields, queries with their handlers and its projection, and the links they start. Refused while anything outside it references what is in it, such as its table or a flow step that invokes a query.

title: Add a query
description: Adds a query to the read model it reads, with the specifications it selects by and the domain services it calls.

title: Change a query
description: Changes a query's title or description, or the specifications it selects by or domain services it calls (each the whole list). Its read model never changes.

title: Remove a query
description: Removes a query with its handler and the links they start. Refused while anything else references them, such as a flow step that invokes it or its endpoint.

title: Add a projection
description: Adds the projection that fills a read model, its one piece of code, with the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses.

title: Change a projection
description: Changes a projection's title, file or description, or the standard rules it meets or packages it uses (each the whole list).

title: Remove a projection
description: Removes a read model's projection with the links it starts and the packages it uses. Refused while anything references it.

title: Add a query handler
description: Adds the handler that answers a query, its one piece of code, with the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses.

title: Change a query handler
description: Changes a query handler's title, file or description, or the standard rules it meets or packages it uses (each the whole list).

title: Remove a query handler
description: Removes a query's handler with the links it starts and the packages it uses. Refused while anything references it.

title: Add a reader
description: Adds a read model's reader, the one way its query handlers read its table, with the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses.

title: Change a reader
description: Changes a reader's title, file or description, or the standard rules it meets or packages it uses (each the whole list).

title: Remove a reader
description: Removes a read model's reader with the links it starts and the packages it uses. Refused while anything references it.

title: Add a table
description: Adds a table under the one entity, read model or domain it stores, with its keys in order, the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses.

title: Change a table
description: Changes a table's title, name, storage or file, its keys (the whole list, in order), or the standard rules it meets or packages it uses (each the whole list). Its parent changes only by a move.

title: Move a table
description: Moves a table, with its keys, under another entity, read model or domain: exactly one is given, and it replaces the parent it had.

title: Remove a table
description: Removes a table whole: its keys, and the links and packages it names. Refused while anything else references it, such as another table's foreign key.

title: Add a view
description: Adds a view: a screen or page a person uses, with its route. It has no owner; its product follows from its ID.

title: Change a view
description: Changes a view's title, route, description or notes.

title: Remove a view
description: Removes a view whole: its view requirements and their view tests and the links they start. Refused while anything outside it references what is in it.

title: Add a view requirement
description: Adds a view requirement under its view: one rule the view must follow.

title: Change a view requirement
description: Changes a view requirement's title, statement or group. Its view does not change.

title: Remove a view requirement
description: Removes a view requirement with its view tests and the links they start. Refused while anything else references them.

title: Add a view test
description: Adds a view test under its view requirement, with the test data sets it starts from.

title: Change a view test
description: Changes a view test's columns or the test data sets it starts from (the whole list). Its requirement does not change.

title: Remove a view test
description: Removes a view test with the links it starts. Refused while anything else references them.

title: Add an endpoint
description: Adds an endpoint under the one command or query it exposes (exactly one of command_id and query_id), titled by its method and route.

title: Change an endpoint
description: Changes an endpoint's title, method, route, description or notes. The command or query it exposes changes only by Move an endpoint.

title: Move an endpoint
description: Moves an endpoint, with everything in it, to the command or query of its domain it now exposes: give exactly one of command_id and query_id.

title: Remove an endpoint
description: Removes an endpoint whole: its API requirements, its handler, its endpoint tests and the links they start. Refused while anything outside it references what is in it.

title: Add an API requirement
description: Adds an API requirement under its endpoint: one rule the endpoint must follow.

title: Change an API requirement
description: Changes an API requirement's title, statement or group. Its endpoint does not change.

title: Remove an API requirement
description: Removes an API requirement with its endpoint tests and the links they start. Refused while anything else references them.

title: Add an endpoint handler
description: Adds an endpoint's handler, its one piece of code that serves it: its name in code and its file, with the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses.

title: Change an endpoint handler
description: Changes an endpoint handler's title, file or description, or the standard rules it meets or the packages it uses (each list whole). Its endpoint does not change.

title: Remove an endpoint handler
description: Removes an endpoint handler with the links it starts and the packages it uses. Refused while anything else references them.

title: Add an endpoint test
description: Adds an endpoint test under its API requirement, with the test data sets it starts from.

title: Change an endpoint test
description: Changes an endpoint test's columns or the test data sets it starts from (the whole list). Its requirement does not change.

title: Remove an endpoint test
description: Removes an endpoint test with the links it starts. Refused while anything else references them.

title: Add an integration
description: Adds an integration: an outside system the product exchanges with. It has no owner; its product follows from its ID.

title: Change an integration
description: Changes an integration's title, system or description.

title: Remove an integration
description: Removes an integration whole: its adapter, its integration tests and the links they start. Refused while anything outside it references what is in it.

title: Add an adapter
description: Adds an integration's adapter, its one piece of code that talks to the outside system: its name in code and its file, with the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses.

title: Change an adapter
description: Changes an adapter's title, file or description, or the standard rules it meets or the packages it uses (each list whole). Its integration does not change.

title: Remove an adapter
description: Removes an adapter with the links it starts and the packages it uses. Refused while anything else references them.

title: Add an integration test
description: Adds an integration test under its integration, with the test data sets it starts from.

title: Change an integration test
description: Changes an integration test's columns or the test data sets it starts from (the whole list). Its integration does not change.

title: Remove an integration test
description: Removes an integration test with the links it starts. Refused while anything else references them.

title: Add a UI component
description: Adds a UI component: its name in code and its file, with the views it renders, the view requirements it builds, the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses. It has no owner; its product follows from its ID.

title: Change a UI component
description: Changes a UI component's title, file or description, or the views it renders, the view requirements it builds, the standard rules it meets or the packages it uses (each list whole).

title: Remove a UI component
description: Removes a UI component whole: the links it starts and the packages it uses. Refused while anything outside it references what is in it.

title: Add a storage requirement
description: Adds a storage requirement under the one aggregate or read model whose data it is about (exactly one of aggregate_id and read_model_id): what of it must be kept, and how well.

title: Change a storage requirement
description: Changes a storage requirement's title or statement. The aggregate or read model it is about never changes: remove it and add it again under another.

title: Remove a storage requirement
description: Removes a storage requirement whole: its storage requirement tests and the links they start. Refused while anything outside it references what is in it.

title: Add a storage requirement test
description: Adds a storage requirement test under its storage requirement, with the test data sets it starts from.

title: Change a storage requirement test
description: Changes a storage requirement test's columns or the test data sets it starts from (the whole list).

title: Remove a storage requirement test
description: Removes a storage requirement test with the links it starts. Refused while anything references it, such as a business outcome it measures.

title: Add a data store
description: Adds a data store under its product or one of its domains (exactly one of product_id and domain_id), with the integration that reaches it when it is a service someone else runs.

title: Change a data store
description: Changes a data store's title, kind or description, or the integration that reaches it (null clears it). Its product or domain never changes: remove it and add it again under another.

title: Remove a data store
description: Removes a data store with the link it starts. Refused while a repository, reader or table is stored in it, naming each.

title: Add a check
description: Adds a check row: its name, the product it belongs to (none for Lathe's own), its place in the run order, its severity, summary, explanation and one SELECT, and the kinds it concerns. A name one of Lathe's checks has is refused.

title: Change a check
description: Changes a check row's place in the run order, severity, summary, explanation, query or kinds. Its name and product do not change, and Lathe's own checks are read-only.

title: Remove a check
description: Removes a product's check row, so it no longer runs; Lathe's own checks are read-only.

title: Set the product's limits
description: Sets a product's settings row: the most children of one kind a record should hold, and the most entities an aggregate should hold. A product without the row takes the defaults, 15 and 7.

title: Open a page
description: a stage switched on the same page replaces the history entry; any other move pushes one (INV01).

title: Remember the page in its space
description: sets the space's Last page and makes it the one last chosen.

title: Fold or unfold a nav row
description: the fold buttons of app/src/shell/Nav.tsx

title: Move in the active tab
description: moveInTab: a click, the arrow and WASD walk, Out and In, quick open, the wiki card's links or the address move the active tab's place, dropping its forward entries and adding one (movePlace); a stage switch on the same page replaces the entry (replacePlace). Never another tab, even one that holds the page.

title: Open a new tab
description: newTab: after the active tab, copying its stage, depth and filters, focused on what was opened, with a fresh history; active, or in the background on a middle-click; at the product on Cmd/Ctrl+T. duplicateTab: a copy of the active tab with its history.

title: Close a tab
description: closeTab: the right neighbor becomes active, or else the left; the last tab leaves one tab on the product.

title: Activate a tab
description: activateTab, cycleTab

title: Change a tab's view
description: updateView: the depth, the kind filters and the wiki card's open and expanded state and scroll of the active tab's place.

title: Choose the graph's layout
description: Sets the graph's layout, Tree or Nested, for the browser session; a layout the graph does not have is refused.

title: Go back or forward in a tab
description: stepTab (stepPlace): Back and Forward step through the active tab's own history, never another tab's.

title: Note how many spaces there are
description: Remembers whether two or more spaces are listed, so the rail shows as it did before the products are read.

title: Open the nav's branch to the page
description: Opens every nav row that holds the current page, down to it.

title: Fold or unfold a nav section
description: Folds or unfolds one of the nav's own sections, kept from one launch to the next.

title: Cycle through the tabs
description: Activates the next or the previous tab of the space, wrapping around.

title: Duplicate a tab
description: Opens a copy of a tab beside it, with its whole place and history and its cameras, and activates it.

title: Change the active tab's address in place
description: Replaces the active tab's current entry with another address, as a stage switched in place does.

title: Note where a tab's page was
description: Notes a value, such as the wiki card's scroll, in the active tab's current history entry.

title: Remember the stage
description: Remembers the stage last chosen, which a place whose address names none starts on.

title: Keep a place's camera
description: Keeps a stage's camera for a place as it is left, with what it framed, so the place comes back as it was.

title: Show or hide the minimap
description: Shows or hides the graph's minimap for the browser session.

title: Resize the wiki card
description: Sets the wiki card's width within its limits, or back to its default.

title: Show or hide the chat
description: Opens or closes the desktop app's chat panel for the browser session.

title: Resize the chat
description: Sets the chat panel's width within its limits, or back to its default.

title: Turn Highlight changes on or off
description: Turns Highlight changes on or off for the browser session.

title: Choose the Changes baseline
description: Sets what Highlight changes compares with: the last commit, the branch, or when the Reader last looked; another baseline is refused.

title: Turn Follow on or off
description: Turns Follow on or off, which opens each changed record as it changes.

title: Mark a product looked at
description: Notes the moment the Reader last looked at a product, which Highlight changes can compare with.

title: Show or hide all links
description: Has the graph's Map draw every link between the records drawn, or only the focus's and the selection's, for the browser session.

title: Resize a panel
description: by drag or keys, within the panel's limits; a double-click resets it; a drag below the fold threshold hides it instead (CMD02).

title: Show or hide a panel
description: Folds a panel away or brings it back, the stage taking its room: the navigation folds to its rail (on a narrow screen it is a drawer that opens and closes) and the wiki card collapses. Whether the navigation shows is kept for the next visit.

title: Choose a theme
description: Puts a theme in use across the whole app at once and keeps the choice; a chosen theme that no longer exists leaves Lathe in use.

title: Choose a color mode
description: Sets Light, Dark or System, which decides which of every theme's two color sets shows; System follows the device.

title: Duplicate a theme
description: Adds an editable copy of a theme under a fresh name ("Workshop copy"), remembering the built-in theme it came from, and puts the copy in use.

title: Import a theme file
description: Adds a theme file as a theme of the person's own, renamed when its name is taken. A file that is not JSON, names another format or version, or holds unknown fields, unknown tokens or values a token does not take is refused with the reason.

title: Edit a theme
description: Changes the name or token values of one of the person's own themes. A built-in theme is never changed, and an edit that would leave the theme invalid is not kept.

title: Reset a theme
description: Puts a copy's token values back to those of the built-in theme it was copied from, keeping the copy's name.

title: Delete a theme
description: Removes one of the person's own themes; when it was in use, Lathe is in use again. A built-in theme cannot be removed.

title: Open a product folder
description: Opens a product folder in a window of its own, or brings its window forward when it is already open. Refused, saying what is missing, for a path that is not a folder, a folder whose `lathe.config.json` is not valid JSON, or one with neither a config nor a data folder.

title: Close a product window
description: Closes a product window, keeping its size and place for the next time, and stops its app server and its chat.

title: Save a window's place
description: Keeps a window's size and position, and whether it is maximized or full screen, by its folder, so the folder opens there next time; a size below the window's minimum is raised to it.

title: Set a window's chrome
description: Applies the window chrome its own page sends, and only from the window's own page.

title: Report a window's error count
description: Sets a window's count of check errors as its page reports it, which the Dock badge shows for the focused window. Refused unless it comes from the window's own page and is a whole number from 0 to 1,000,000.

title: Start a window's app server
description: Starts what a window loads Lathe from: `serve()` on the port the folder's server had last time when it is free, else on a free local port other than 5199, from the product's own installed Lathe or else the app's bundled copy, and keeps the port it got; or in development the Owner's dev server on 5199 or one of the shell's own. Refused when Lathe is not built or no free port is found.

title: Stop a window's app server
description: Stops a window's app server: it takes no new requests, finishes those in progress and closes the database. A shared dev server is left running.

title: Serve a product repo
description: Serves the built web app and the API for one product repo on a local port, telling open pages when the data changes, until it is stopped. Refused when the web app is not built.

title: Add a recent folder
description: Puts a folder first in the recent folders, listing it once however its path is spelled and keeping at most 10.

title: Clear the recent folders
description: Empties the recent folders, and the system's recent documents with them.

title: Set up a product repo
description: `lathe init`: writes `lathe.config.json` and adds the product with the Product aggregate's own command, Add a product.

title: Opt out of window restoration
description: As the shell starts, tells macOS to keep no window state for Lathe, which reopens its own product windows.

title: Upgrade a product's data
description: `lathe upgrade`: runs the converters from the product's schema version to Lathe's on the raw rows of the data files, then raises the config's schema version once the converted data loads; lists what it could not convert.

title: Start the plugin's tools for a product repo
description: The plugin's MCP launcher: finds the product repo and its installed Lathe, starts its `lathe mcp`, and warns once when the plugin's skills were written for another major version.

title: Open a Claude Code session
description: Starts the window's chat on a new session, a saved one resumed (`--resume`) or a fork of one (`--fork-session`): the user's own `claude` runs headless in the folder, the saved conversation shown first, with the Lathe plugin of the Lathe the window runs (`--plugin-dir`), told how to work beside the window, in the mode the folder's last chat had; the Lathe tools it gets are counted for the head.

title: Send a message to Claude
description: Writes the Owner's message to the chat's CLI as a stream-json user line, with what they are looking at as a context block before it unless they removed the chip, starting the CLI again on the session when it has ended.

title: Answer a permission prompt
description: Answers the CLI's can_use_tool request with a control response: allow once, or allow the tool always in this chat (its later prompts are allowed without asking), with the tool's input unchanged, or deny. A prompt the chat's mode decides is answered without asking: Accept reads and View only allow the reads, Bypass allows everything, and View only refuses a tool that may change things, saying why.

title: Stop Claude's turn
description: Sends the CLI an interrupt control request; the turn ends, its waiting prompts are withdrawn, and the chat waits for the next message.

title: Open a record for Claude
description: The MCP tool app_open, and `lathe app open` from a shell: moves the window's focus to a record, on the stage asked for, through the window's app bridge; refused for a record the window does not have, or when no window is connected.

title: Choose an editor
description: Sets the editor Open in editor uses, keeping the rest of settings.json; an editor Lathe does not know, or a custom one with no command, is refused.

title: Open the settings file
description: Opens settings.json in the editor, writing it first with an empty editor command to fill in when it is missing.

title: Reveal a record's data file
description: Shows the data file that holds the record in the system file manager; the shell finds the file from the record ID alone.

title: Open a record's data file in the editor
description: Opens the data file that holds the record in the chosen editor; the shell finds the file from the record ID alone.

title: Copy a record's ID
description: Copies the record's ID to the clipboard.

title: Show a record's menu
description: Opens the native menu of a record: open in a new tab, reveal its data file, open it in the editor, copy its ID.

title: Reveal a product folder
description: Shows a window's product folder in the system file manager, from its launch or error page.

title: Turn scroll to zoom on or off
description: Sets whether scroll zooms the Graph's, the ERD's and the Trace's cameras, Cmd or Ctrl with scroll panning them, or pans them as it does by default; for every tab and kept from one launch to the next.

title: Bind a key
description: Gives a shortcut a key the person pressed in the shortcuts sheet, in place of one of its keys or beside them. A key another shortcut has where both apply is refused naming it, unless swapped: then that shortcut gets the key given up, or just loses it.

title: Remove a binding
description: Takes a key off a shortcut. Its last key only on purpose: the shortcut is then left without a key.

title: Reset a shortcut
description: Gives a changed shortcut its default keys again; refused, naming it, when another shortcut has taken one of them since.

title: Reset all shortcuts
description: Gives every shortcut its default keys again, after the person confirms in the shortcuts sheet.

title: Report a window's keys
description: Keeps the keys the person bound in a window's page, as it sends them when they change, so the menu shows them beside its commands while that window has focus. Refused unless it comes from the window's own page; anything that is not a list of key texts by command is dropped.

title: Choose the chat's permission mode
description: Sets the window's chat to Ask, Accept reads, Auto, Bypass or View only: the chat's CLI starts again on its session with that mode's flags, and the folder keeps the mode for its next chat. Refused while a turn is under way, or for a mode Lathe does not know.

title: Turn voice activation on or off
description: Sets whether the chat listens for the wake phrase while the window is in front; kept from one launch to the next.

title: Turn Quick mode on or off
description: Sets whether a dictated message is sent by itself once the Owner has finished; kept from one launch to the next.

title: Choose the voice phrases
description: Sets the wake phrase and each voice command's words; refused with every reason when they break the voice phrases' rule.

title: Listen for the voice, or stop
description: Starts or stops the window's listening: the first time, macOS asks for the microphone; the window listens only while it is in front. Refused where the Mac cannot recognize on-device, or the microphone is denied.

title: Choose the chat's model and effort
description: Sets the window's chat to Opus, Sonnet or Haiku (or Claude Code's default) and an effort from low to max: the chat's CLI starts again on its session with --model and --effort, and the log says so. Refused while a turn is under way, or for a model or effort Lathe does not know.

title: Take a message out of the queue
description: Removes a message the Owner sent while Claude worked, before it goes; the messages left keep their order. Refused for a message that has already gone.

title: Capture the stage
description: Answers the pixels of a rectangle of the window as a PNG, for the Owner to send Claude the stage as it is drawn. Refused for a rectangle that is not finite, is empty or is larger than a screen, and nothing outside the window is read.

title: Undo a turn's changes
description: Rolls the product back to the rows the server kept when the chat's turn began, through the aggregates' own commands in reverse and in one write: records the turn added are removed, records it removed are added again and records it changed are changed back. Refused, with every reason and nothing changed, for a record whose kind has no command to put it back, one something since depends on, or one that changed again after the turn.

title: Follow a pattern
description: Makes a domain or use case follow a pattern, with the value, or the reason it does not apply, it gives each of the pattern's settings.

title: Change the setting values
description: Gives a followed pattern's settings their values, or the reasons they do not apply: the list replaces the follower's values for that pattern.

title: Stop following a pattern
description: Ends a domain's or use case's following of a pattern, with the setting values it gave it.
